purpose: Validate whether past ability to hold a forward position under a fast first-3F adds information beyond the existing first-corner queue model.
universe: JRA flat, field_size>=12, 3-win class or higher

history_rule.fast_first3f_definition: condition-specific first quartile fixed from pre-OOS data through 2023
history_rule.grade_A: at least one fast-first3F prior run and mean normalized frontness in those fast runs >= 0.70
history_rule.grade_B: at least one fast-first3F prior run but grade_A threshold not met
history_rule.grade_C: no qualifying fast-first3F prior run; treated as unknown, not negative

target: queue-model residual in normalized early-position fraction; negative means the horse actually raced farther forward than the baseline queue model predicted
notes: This is a one-sided auxiliary signal: only Grade A has validated positive interpretation.
Grade C means insufficient fast-pace evidence, not poor pursuit ability.
The signal belongs to the queue/early-position layer and must not be merged directly into M3 or market probabilities without a separate OOS validation.
